subject: [PATCH v8 4/7] mm/memcontrol: check PF_MEMALLOC after trying the limits

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch modifies the behavior of memory charging in Linux to check for PF_MEMALLOC after trying limits, rather than before. This change is necessary because a later patch moves the memory stock into the page counter, leaving no room between consuming the stock and trying limits for the PF_MEMALLOC check. The patch checks for PF_MEMALLOC on both outcomes of the page counter charge, skipping memory.high on success and forcing the charge on failure.
